entities.summary: Siglo XX is a tin mine in Bolivia. It is located in the city of Llallagua in the province of Bustillos, Potosí Department. Along with the Catavi mine, it is part of a mining complex in the area. Siglo Veinte mine is a mine from Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
